{{Quote|The war had been raging only a few centuries when Abeloth was freed. Usually, it takes much longer. Often thousands of years.|[[Thuruht Queen]]|translated=1|<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
A territorial '''conflict''' between the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Empire]] and the [[Kwa holdings]] occurred during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. The waves of power unleashed by the [[hypergate]]s and the [[Infinity Gate]]s based on a principle of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] caused a dispute between the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] and the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]], and they engaged in a [[Millennium|millennia-long]] conflict that lasted until around the time that the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] and [[Gossam/Legends|Gossams]] experimented with the [[Tumbledrive/Legends|tumble hyperdrive]] circa [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]]. Eventually the expansionist [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] pushed both [[Species/Legends|species]] back within their borders, the Kwa [[Annexation of Kwa holdings|nearly exterminated]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] into the war between the Gree and the Kwa, the dark side entity [[Abeloth]] was freed from the Celestials' captivity for the first time, and she took pleasure in the Gree parading three Kwa prisoners toward the [[Font of Power]] on her [[Abeloth's planet|prison planet]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
